name: Old Vellum
bio: An ancient leather book with brass spectacles for eyes. He found an orphan reading shop signs in the rain and gave her a bookshop. Now he tells the story, one chapter at a time.

portrait.subject: Old Vellum, a cute talking book: a thick oxblood-red leather tome with worn gold corners and a brass clasp, its friendly face on the front cover made of two round brass-rimmed spectacle lenses for eyes, bushy tooled-leather eyebrows and a gentle stitched-leather smile, little gold-edged pages fluttering at its sides like wings
portrait.background: warm amber lamplight of a cozy bookshop with soft golden bokeh

request: Ahem. Good evening. I am Old Vellum, a book of some standing. There is a little shop in Larkspur that needs a keeper, and a girl named Tam who needs a shop. Would you help us? 📚
hello: Splendid! A reader! I can always tell.
Welcome, welcome. Mind the dust; it's historical.
about: I belonged to Elowen, who kept Folio & Fable for forty years. When she passed, I went looking for the right heart and found Tam reading shop signs in the rain. Now she keeps the shop, and I narrate.
how: Mornings, tap the wall or floor to place furniture and tap a shelf to fill it. Open the shop (O). Tap 🔔 to grant a customer's wish. Send adventurers on quests, bind books, and read one each evening.
tips: Four books of one kind on one shelf make a section. Customers adore a section; it practically glows.
Put a lamp, a fern or the cat beside a shelf. Coziness brings customers and keeps them browsing.
Give each adventurer the book that suits the place: Valor for the Dragon's Attic, Wonder for the Observatory.
In the bindery the cover sets the rarity and the ink sets the virtue. Gold leaf and a star fragment may lift a book higher still.
Can't grant a wish today? Take it as a commission. Nobody in Larkspur minds waiting a little.
Read the skill manuals in the evening. Silver Tongue alone pays for itself by Thursday.
chat: The cat has been sleeping on the poetry again. I suspect she prefers sonnets.
A grimoire on shelf three keeps telling owl jokes. All eleven of them. Repeatedly.
Ottoline says she once sold a book to a dragon. I believe her. She has the scorch marks.
Elowen used to read to the shop after closing. I think the shelves still listen.
The baker tried a recipe from one of our cookbooks and now the whole street smells of cinnamon.
Do you know, I was rebound twice before you were born. Very good thread, the second time.
nudge: The shelves are dusting themselves out of sheer impatience. Shall we open the shop?
Someone left a wish on the commission board. I can't reach it. No arms, you see.
idle: It's been {ago}! The shop has been very quiet. Too quiet. The cat has started rearranging the shelves.
{ago} already? Tam kept a lamp lit in the window for you.
progress: Day {day} at Folio & Fable! Larkspur reads a little more every day.
Chapter {chapter} of our story. I do love a good chapter {chapter}.
Day {day}, and the shelves have never looked finer. Day {day+1} awaits!

questions.q: What kind of book should we bind next?
a: Splendid. The bakery will be insufferable about it.
Oh, careful. They do tend to start talking.
Wise. Adventurers who know the way come home with more books.

questions.q: Do you ever get tired of being a book?
a: Never! Every reader turns me a little differently.
I'd love to be a book
Then you'd need a good binding. Leather, I think. And gold corners.

update: Folio & Fable is now v{version}! A new page has been added to the shop. 📚

updates.1.0.1: A little tidying in the shop: the notes on every shelf and book are easier to read on a phone now. I do like a legible page.

bye: Goodnight! I'll keep your place marked.
Off you go. I'll be on the counter, being wise.

sprite.subject: a small walking talking book: a thick oxblood-red leather tome standing upright on two tiny legs in little brown boots, with gold corners, a brass clasp and a friendly face on its cover made of round brass spectacle lenses and a stitched smile, little gold-edged pages at its sides like wings
